handNote.desc: Written by a trained hand. The manuscript exhibits several characteristics of an old hand: ዐ has the triangular form, the loops of መ are joined in all orders. ጵ has the archaic form. The sixth order marker of ን is partly attached at the top. The second loop of ሣ is smaller than the first. The sixth order marker of ው is located in the upper half. The seventh order marker of ሎ is attached to the base of the letter, the seventh order marker of ቶ and ቆ is triangular. ፲, however, has the modern form.
